market_assessment.text: TAIEX crashed -1.20% (-548.59 pts) to 45,308.68, breaking below the 45,500 support. Open-high-close-low pattern: opened 45,922 near prev close, intraday high 46,064, then relentless selling to close near the low of 45,225. Three institutions net sold -239.30B NTD - foreign -119.86B (reversal from +454.47B buy on Monday), proprietary -176.07B (hedge -154.34B), only trust +56.63B provided support. Futures: foreign TX OI net short -83,474 (slightly reduced), P/C volume ratio spiked to 126.34% from 103.18% - fear hedging surge. VIX +11.58% to 15.90 confirms rising fear. Semiconductor -1.48%, Electronics -1.52%, Computer Peripheral -1.97% led losses. Defensive sectors gained: Shipping +2.09%, Oil/Gas +1.01%, Financials +0.73%. Breadth collapse: 798 down vs 219 up stocks, 116 limit down. Recommendation results: 2330 MISS (-0.83%), 2308 MISS (-3.45%, stop hit), 6505 HIT (intraday target hit). 2/3 misses on VIX spike day - confirms Rule 9 (VIX >5% spike = downgrade all bullish).
